items.Sentence: Recent changes will include replacing the existing Parshall Flume flow metering structure with a magnetic flow meter on the pump discharge line.
The RWD describes the City's plans to install a new 5,000-gallon storage tank for septage receiving, management, and equalization.

The RWD describes the City's plans to construct Biolac System©, which is an extended aeration biological treatment process with diffused fine bubble aeration to replace the existing mechanical surface aerated pond system.
to replace the existing mechanical surface aerated pond system.
The Biolac system will utilize the existing CM Lagoon 1 and will bring the treatment capacity to 2 mgd. The WWTF will consist of an aeration basin (CM Lagoon 1)...
The WWTF will consist of an aeration basin (CM Lagoon 1), two concrete clarifiers...
The WWTF will consist of ... return and waste activated sludge pumps...
The WWTF will consist of ... aerobic sludge digester ... Sludge from the clarifiers will be pumped to the aerobic sludge digester.
Digested sludge, at approximately 2-6 percent solids, will be pumped to reinforced concrete sludge drying beds during the summer and mechanically dewatered in the winter.
Sludge will then be hauled offsite to a permitted facility.
Effluent from the clarifiers will be discharged to Storage Ponds A through C (current PM Lagoons 1 through 3).
The City proposes converting Settling Ponds 1 and 2 to Disposal Ponds.
In total, the City will have seven Disposal Ponds (Disposal Ponds 1 through 3 and 5 through 8) with a total storage capacity of 338 acre-feet.
